verdict.rationale: pnpm documents ECDSA registry-signature verification of installed packages against each registry's published keys, but this runs as a separate audit step on packages already installed, not as an automatic gate before they run. The `--update-checksums` opt-in implies install-time checksum verification is enforced by default, but this is only implied. Frozen lockfiles in CI and blocking install scripts by default add related protection. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of checksum/integrity enforcement at fetch time, signature verification as a pre-execution install gate rather than a post-install audit, provenance/attestation verification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
